title: Class trainers and tier advancement, re-derived from the final client
purpose: Replaces the lost research/20260914-class-trainer specification (class-trainer-spec.json, rules R1.x-R5.1) that ClassAdvancement, ManifestationManager and CharacterManager cite. Every rule below names the client data it was decoded from, so ClassTrainerEvidenceTests can check the implementation against it.
research_dir: /home/blizz/backups/rasa-net/research/20260926-trainers-economy (the marker decoder and this file's generator in work/, TaRapedia revisions in wiki/, the archived official notes in web/, the navmesh probe output work/probe.out)

client.method: Static only: xdis 6.3.0 (vendored) unmarshals each .pyo; generated literal tables are read with research/20260926-mission-catalog/tools/decode_literal_table.py, uimapmarker.pyo with a stack interpreter over the trdis.py disassembly (research/20260926-segment3-audit/work/trdis.py), code modules by reading their disassembly. No client code was imported or executed. The TRAINER markers agree record for record with research/20260926-segment3-audit/work/trainer-map-markers.json.

rules.rule: Each class trains only into its immediate children.
sources: characterclass.pyo (constants RECRUIT=1 .. EXOBIOLOGIST=15)

gameuiutil.pyo g_ClassTree (built at code offsets 1425-1865; Soldier/Specialist under Recruit, Commando/Ranger under Soldier, Sapper/Biotechnician under Specialist, Grenadier/Guardian under Commando, Sniper/Spy under Ranger, Demolitionist/Engineer under Sapper, Medic/Exobiologist under Biotechnician)

rules.rule: The tier levels are 5, 15 and 30; a trainer is needed to advance there.
sources: uielementlanguage.pyo (5695,1): "If you've reached a tier level (5, 15, or 30), you'll want to visit a trainer to select a class advancement. Trainers are located in all major AFS-occupied bases and cities."
official class pages (docs/source-sweep-2026-09-13.md): Recruit 01, Soldier/Specialist 05, tier 3 15, tier 4 30

rules.rule: A class is held at the level before its tier level; experience keeps accruing.
sources: video 8VXeKzGUv0c B2 (the Recruit reaches 4, message 663 follows, the experience bar stays full; docs/character-progression-client-evidence.md 'Implementation, 2026-09-14')
playermessagelanguage.pyo (663,1): "You will not advance in level until you visit a trainer and choose a new character class to advance in."

rules.rule: Reaching the gate sends player message 663 once, then AvailableCharacterClasses.
sources: playermessagelanguage.pyo (663,1)
video 8VXeKzGUv0c B2 (order after the level-up line)

rules.rule: One clone credit is granted at the tier choice; the trainer window shows it before training.
sources: video 8VXeKzGUv0c B2 (trainer window shows one credit on the Recruit)
official Paul Sage guide, 2008-02-01 (a credit at each tier choice; docs/retail-accuracy.md)
TaRapedia 'Leveling Up' rev 36344 (2009-03-04): 'Just before the training you'll also recieve a Clone Credit'

rules.rule: The tier window closes when the player is dead or beyond MAX_MISSION_SHARE_RANGE (20) of the trainer.
sources: gameconstants.pyo MAX_MISSION_SHARE_RANGE = 20 (code offset 1950)
actor.pyo IsInMissionShareRange: body.InRadiusOf(other.body, MAX_MISSION_SHARE_RANGE)
tierselect.pyo Update, source lines 202-208: hides when avatar.IsDead() or not avatar.IsInMissionShareRange(actor)

rules.rule: The single trainer speaks the generic group: 337 can train, 339 nothing left to teach, 340 not ready yet.

value.337: Greetings Soldier! \r\n\r\nI'm here to train you, regardless of your specialty. Just don't forget to clone. If you clone now, you'll be able to explore a different path later; otherwise you'll be stuck forever with your decision.
value.339: You already know all I can teach you, soldier. Now get out there and put it to use!
value.340: You think you're ready for training? Well you're not - yet. Come back when you've got a little more action under your belt and we'll talk about training you in the ways of AFS.

sources: npctrainerdialoglanguage.pyo keys (337,1), (339,1), (340,1)

rules.rule: Training is offered as CONVO_TYPE_TRAINING (bCanTrain, dialogId); the client needs no npc package to converse or train.
sources: npc.pyo CanTrain (source lines 245-254): trainingInfo = convoDataDict.get(CONVO_TYPE_TRAINING); unpacks (bCanTrain, dialogId); returns bCanTrain
npc.pyo _GetUseAction (source lines 60-66): the CONVERSE action exists whenever convoStatus != CONVO_STATUS_NONE
npc.pyo Recv_NPCInfo only stores npcPackageId (used for objective dialogue, not training)

rules.rule: SelectNewCharacterClass(classId) names no trainer: the server checks a living player at the gate, near a trainer, choosing an immediate child.
sources: tierselect.pyo (request shape; docs/character-progression-client-evidence.md)
CT-TREE
CT-RANGE

rules.rule: Cloning spends one credit from character selection into an empty pod; attributes and skills reset, Logos kept.
sources: charactercreation.pyo OnCreateCharacter: RequestCloneCharacterToSlot(sourceSlot, destinationSlot, name, gender, height, appearanceData, raceId)
official live notes 2008-01-29/30 (attribute and skill reset)
official Wilderness walkthrough (Logos persist through cloning)
2009-01-25 Beginners Guide (completed missions carried; an undated fan guide disagrees)
rules.unverified: the complete copied-state list, arrival position, and whether a clone made at the gate gets its own tier credit

rules.rule: Since D12 (live 2008-09-18) each hub that had trainers has one single class trainer who trains every class; the per-class trainers are obsolete.
sources: official live notes 'Deployment 12.5: 9/18/2008' (playtr.com/news/patch_notes/deployment_125_9182008.html, Wayback 20081018170941; copy research/20260926-trainers-economy/web/): "Deployment 12 is on Live! It features a new version of the tier selection process ..." and, under UI, "The tier selection process has changed in several ways.  Individual trainers for each class have been replaced by one single trainer on maps that had trainers previously."

the same text on TaRapedia 'Updates/2008-09-18' (pageid 11400, rev 35871): "The tier selection process has changed in several ways. Individual trainers for each class have been replaced by one single trainer on maps that had trainers previously."

TaRapedia 'Updates/2008-08-14' and 'Updates/2008-08-15' (rev 35870, 32222): "Many unnecessary class trainers have been removed from all maps. Players should no longer find Tier 4 trainers in maps earlier than Mires, and should no longer find Tier 2 and 3 trainers after Mires."
npctrainerdialoglanguage.pyo (337,1): "I'm here to train you, regardless of your specialty."
trainer_markers below: one TRAINER marker per hub on every live map; per-class markers only in the unused wargame template 2269
